preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200,000) representing the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= 2 * 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[1:1+n])
preconditions.description: The second line contains n integers a_1, ..., a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 200,000) representing the numbers on the vertices.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(len(edge) == 2 and 1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and x != y for edge in stdin.split()[1+n:].split() if edge)
preconditions.description: The next n-1 lines contain pairs of integers (x, y) representing edges of the tree (1 ≤ x, y ≤ n, x ≠ y). The edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree).
The input consists of exactly n+1 lines (1 for n, 1 for a_i, and n-1 for edges).

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == '' or (len(line.split()) == 2 and int(line.split()[0]) == i and int(line.split()[1]) >= 0) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.split('\n'), 1) if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each integer i from 1 to 200,000, if there exists at least one pair (x, y) with x ≤ y such that g(x, y) = i, then the output contains a line 'i count', where count is the number of such pairs. Otherwise, no line is output for i.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) == i for i, line in enumerate(stdout.split('\n'), 1) if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: The output lines are ordered by ascending integer i (1 ≤ i ≤ 200,000).

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) == i and int(line.split()[1]) == sum(1 for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(x, n+1) if g(x, y) == i) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.split('\n'), 1) if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each output line 'i count', count is the exact number of pairs (x, y) with x ≤ y such that g(x, y) = i, where g(x, y) is the GCD of all vertex values on the simple path from x to y (inclusive).
